MainComponents.name: HVAC Control Module
MainComponents.description: Manages heating, ventilation, and air conditioning functions based on driver input and sensor data.

MainComponents.name: Blower Motor
MainComponents.description: Forces air through the HVAC system into the cabin.

MainComponents.name: Blower Motor Resistor / Control Module
MainComponents.material: Resistor element in plastic housing or electronic control module

MainComponents.name: Heater Core
MainComponents.description: Transfers heat from engine coolant to the cabin air.

MainComponents.name: Evaporator Core
MainComponents.description: Absorbs heat from cabin air to provide cooling.

AirDistributionComponents.name: Air Mix Door Actuator
AirDistributionComponents.description: Controls air temperature by blending hot and cold air.

AirDistributionComponents.name: Mode Door Actuator
AirDistributionComponents.description: Directs airflow to different vents (floor, dash, defrost).

AirDistributionComponents.name: Recirculation Door Actuator
AirDistributionComponents.description: Controls recirculation of cabin air versus outside air.

Sensors.name: Cabin Temperature Sensor
Sensors.description: Measures cabin temperature to adjust HVAC output.

Sensors.name: Ambient Temperature Sensor
Sensors.description: Detects outside air temperature for HVAC logic.

Sensors.name: Sunload Sensor
Sensors.description: Measures sunlight intensity to optimize climate control.

Sensors.name: Evaporator Temperature Sensor
Sensors.description: Prevents evaporator freezing by monitoring coil temperature.

SupportingHardware.name: Ducts and Vents
SupportingHardware.description: Channels air from HVAC unit to cabin.

SupportingHardware.name: HVAC Mounting Brackets
SupportingHardware.description: Secures HVAC components inside the dashboard or engine bay.

SupportingHardware.name: Hoses and Clamps
SupportingHardware.description: Connects coolant and refrigerant lines to the HVAC system.

SupportingHardware.name: Blower Motor Resistors Wiring
SupportingHardware.description: Connects resistors and actuators to the HVAC control module.
